defaults.caption_suffix: Underscore for a calm spoken documentary: sparse and quiet, the 1-4 kHz voice range left open, no vocals, no drums, no sudden hits, slow even dynamics.

cues.name: S0
cues.caption: Cinematic ambient overture of wonder and awe. A solo felt piano leads with a slow, hopeful melody in the upper register over long warm string pads and soft celesta sparkles, wide stereo, long hall reverb, a gradual swell toward a luminous open chord, like looking at a distant star.

cues.name: S1
cues.caption: Light, playful chamber miniature. Pizzicato strings and a soft marimba trade a simple bouncy motif, a felt piano adds short staccato notes, airy and curious, like a puzzle on squared paper, small and intimate room.

cues.name: S2
cues.caption: Curious, slightly tense underscore. A felt piano plays quiet repeated eighth notes in the middle register over a low sustained cello drone, occasional soft pizzicato, a feeling of measuring something that will not come out exact, restrained, steady pulse without percussion.

cues.name: S3
cues.caption: Flowing minimalist piece of waves. Rippling harp and piano arpeggios in overlapping cycles, like interfering waves, over soft string pads, gently shimmering, slowly evolving phase patterns in the style of minimalism, bright and clear.

cues.name: S4
cues.caption: Mysterious, glassy and spacious. Glass harmonica and celesta tones, soft bowed vibraphone, a slow felt piano figure that folds back on itself, deep string pad, a sense of infinite tiled space and hidden symmetry, wide reverb.

cues.name: S5
cues.caption: Gently mechanical and inventive. A clockwork pulse of soft muted piano and plucked strings, a music-box motif, warm analog synth pad underneath, three short contrasting figures that answer each other, like pressing buttons on an elegant instrument, curious and bright.

cues.name: S6
cues.caption: Reflective and deep, slowly building. A solo felt piano plays a contemplative theme, mirrored phrases answering each other, warm cello and viola lines enter later, a luminous swell in the second half that turns hopeful, like standing before a mirror at the edge of a great mystery.

cues.name: S7
cues.caption: Building and hopeful, a relay across a bridge. Felt piano ostinato passing a motif between instruments, strings joining one by one, a soft horn line, gradual layered crescendo, steady forward motion, earnest and determined, cinematic but restrained.

cues.name: S8
cues.caption: Warm, triumphant and tender finale. A light running piano figure at first, then a full warm string ensemble and felt piano restate a hopeful theme, sparkling celesta and harp glissandi near the end like light dancing, ending on a long luminous major chord that fades out.
